row.team_price_text: Pro Team: $13/seat/mo billed yearly, starts at 5 seats
row.evidence: Scribe's pricing table ticks SCIM user provisioning only for Enterprise ("Available with select Enterprise modules"), and its help centre says "SCIM is available on select Enterprise plans."
row.notes: SAML SSO and SCIM are Enterprise only (custom pricing); SCIM is on select Enterprise modules (Base, Core, Hub, Grid, Global), so not every Enterprise customer gets it. Pro Team is $13/seat/mo billed yearly ($17 monthly) with a 5-seat minimum; Pro Personal ($25 yearly) is single-user. SCIM requires SSO with login method 'SSO Only'. IdP-side deactivation or deletion deactivates the Scribe account and releases the licence. Setup is self-service via a generated configuration link; which IdPs are supported for SCIM, the base URL and the attributes are not published. Scribe is not in the Okta OIN or the Entra app gallery. No user-management API: the only public API is the Enterprise search API.

auth.token_source: Settings > SCIM Provisioning > Start Setup generates a customized configuration link with the connection details

deprovision.data_retained: Account is deactivated (also when the user is deleted in the IdP); content is preserved and a System Admin can reassign it.

roles.how: Directory groups are mapped in Scribe to a team plus a role (System Admin, Team Admin, Creator, Viewer; Optimize roles), one group per team/role combination.

limitations.text: Requires SSO set up and the login method set to SSO Only.
Enabling SCIM overwrites existing team memberships with directory groups; users not in a mapped group lose access, and all user management moves to the IdP.
Only on select Enterprise plans/modules; existing customers must contact Customer Success.
An Optimize user can be a Participant in only one team.

scim.notes: Setup is self-service from a generated configuration link (hosted connection portal); Scribe does not publish the SCIM base URL, schema, attributes, endpoints or supported operations beyond provisioning, deprovisioning and group-to-team/role mapping. Provisioning can be paused or the connection reset.

limitations.text: The only public API is the Enterprise search API (document search, team lookup), on Enterprise Grid and Global; no user-management endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: OIN search for 'scribe' returns only an unrelated SWA app (DataSafe Authorized Subscribers).

entra.notes: No Scribe entry in the Microsoft Entra SaaS app tutorial index (toc.json).
